standaloneRustConsumer: passed with the fastdb-production profile; 342 registry/git package identities match the workspace lockfile
upgradeRestore: Immutable 1.0.0/2.0.0/2.1.0/2.2.0/2.3.0/2.4.0/2.5.0/2.5.1/2.5.2/2.5.3/2.5.4/2.6.0/2.7.0/2.8.0 libraries, driven by the version-range table in scripts/upgrade_matrix.py; candidate writes, reopen, rollback, unchanged previous backups and independent restores. 1.0.0 and 2.4.0 refuse files with a new-format spatial index; 2.5.0 to 2.8.0 read files written by 2.9.0.

spatial.explainReadsNoData: metered EXPLAIN reports zero rows read for every spatial form (spatial_explain_reads_no_documents_or_index_entries)

relationalJoins.recordText: document fields compared with relational TEXT record IDs (=, !=, IS, IS NOT, IN/NOT IN subqueries) match the record; other values and native NULL results unchanged (select, scalar_subqueries suites)
relationalJoins.unqualifiedNames: collection-only fields resolve unqualified; relational column names need qualification unless every collection is strict without the field; bare collection alias returns the document
relationalJoins.bundledCli: the production CLI joins a TEXT users:tan reference to users:tan with ON u.id = p.user_id
relationalJoins.cloud: Cloud runs the 2.9.0 engine since 2026-10-16, so the join forms work on Cloud

keywordColumns: a relational query whose subquery reads a document table returns unaliased keyword columns (plan, key) under their own names (keyword_columns_keep_their_names_when_a_document_table_appears_in_a_subquery)

cloudQueryVersion3.nodeSdk: Cloud URLs send x-fastdb-query-version: 3 with canonical base64 Binary/Vector parameters and 1 MiB request bodies; local services and embedded databases keep version 2 and 64 KiB; responses decode byte arrays and base64; saved writes are version 2 and record their query version; version 1 saved writes replay at version 2 (client.test.cjs)
cloudQueryVersion3.cli: Cloud reads and queries send version 3 with 1 MiB bodies; query journals version 4 and read journals version 5; 2.8.0 journals replay without the header (check-cloud-cli.py)
cloudQueryVersion3.cloud: FastDB Cloud accepts version 3 since 2026-10-16 (Worker 6393d359) and keeps version 2 for 2.8.0 and older clients

supportedScope.ownership: One owning process per database file; shared clients connect to its service
